key_impacts: At least five million people were affected across multiple countries.
More than one million persons were displaced.
Many hospitals and health centres were destroyed or damaged; health workers were among the victims.
Water supplies were disrupted and contaminated; sanitation and sewage systems were damaged.
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004 a 9.0 earthquake off northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
At least five million people were affected in Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, India, Thailand, Seychelles, Myanmar.
The death toll exceeded 280,000 and more than one million were displaced.
missing_information: Specific coastal areas affected within each country.

Exact counts of damaged or destroyed health facilities.
